import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] use = new long[17];

    public static int compute(long num, int digit) {
        int total = (int)((num / use[digit]) * digit);
        num %= use[digit];
        if (num == 0) return total;
        int option1 = compute(use[digit] - (int)num, digit - 1) + digit;
        int option2 = compute((int)num, digit - 1);
        return total + Math.min(option1, option2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        use[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= 16; ++i) {
            use[i] = use[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long number = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(compute(number, 16));
        sc.close();
    }
}
